name: Mozonic
original_description: Mozonic is a music production tool for mixing and mastering. Analyze a mix's frequency balance, dynamics, and loudness, queue DSP autofix corrections, render existing stem sessions, master tracks to streaming loudness targets, and download the finished audio from your Mozonic Pro library.
